description: Return one entry from the bot catalog by exact id. Output is that entry alone, not wrapped in entries or count: id, name, maker, description, protocols (strings), url, license (string or null), license_verified, license_url (string or null), verified_at (YYYY-MM-DD), http_status (integer or null), archive_url (string or null), funds_or_keys, and notes. funds_or_keys is true when the software can access a wallet or keys. Parameter id is required. It must equal list_bots entries[].id. Catalog ids are lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Example: lnget. Do not include the bot: prefix that list_changes uses; strip it first. A missing id is rejected as invalid input. An unknown id returns isError with text No bot with id <id>. A failed read of /bots.json returns isError. The text is the Error message (Fetch failed <status> <url> when the HTTP status is not OK), or Bot lookup failed. when the failure is not an Error. Use get_bot instead of list_bots when you already have one id. Use list_bots instead when you need the catalog, the count, the disclaimer, or the inclusion rule, or when you do not know the id. Use search_sources instead for papers and docs about agents. Listed, not endorsed. Free, no auth.

id.description: Required. Exact entries[].id from list_bots. Catalog ids are lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Example: lnget. Do not include the bot: prefix that list_changes uses; strip it first. A missing id is invalid input. Any other string that is not in the catalog returns isError text No bot with id <id>.

name: get_bot
title: Get one verified bot
